pages.title: Winter’s Arrow
pages.text: Choose between frost projectiles and a control wall.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Find this bow in world loot and read its expanded Alt tooltip. Pain concentrates shots; Grace stacks slowness; Bounty adds weaker arrows; Chaos creates an ice wall blocking entities and projectiles.
